conviction_note: The baseline's 1.5% is not an earnings base rate: MoneyHero's two identifiable real earnings reactions are +1.53% (FY25, 2026-04-30) and -18.91% (Q1 2026, 2026-06-24 on 555k shares vs a 19.5k median), so the honest absolute move here is high-single to low-double digits; I land at +2.0 net because a genuinely favourable operating quarter (record HK/SG capital-markets activity in Apr-Jun against MoneyHero's structural Q1 trough) is partly offset by the same non-cash FX line that turned a good Q1 operating print into a $6.7m headline net loss and a 19% fall.

findings.finding: MoneyHero's Q2 (Apr-Jun 2026) falls in the strongest half-year Hong Kong and Singapore retail-financial-product acquisition environment on record - HKEX's 1H 2026 cash-market headline ADT was HK$283.0bn, up 18% YoY with record half-yearly highs in cash, derivatives and Connect - against MoneyHero's own structural trough quarter (Q1 2026 revenue $16.5m after Q4 2025's $20.0m, with Wealth +53% YoY and Hong Kong +33% YoY already levered to exactly that activity) and the easiest comp in the sequence ($18.0m in Q2 2025, itself down 13% YoY); Q4 2025 already proved that ~$20m of quarterly revenue on the post-restructuring cost base delivers positive Adjusted EBITDA (+$0.7m) and net profit (+$0.5m).
findings.why_not_priced: There is one published estimate on the name (EPS -$0.02), no option chain at all, and the stock sits 1.2% off its 52-week low having drifted -10.2% over 20 days - a tape consistent with zero expectation of an EBITDA-positive quarter. If the market had joined MoneyHero's Q1 vertical disclosure to the HKEX/SGX activity data, the stock would not be within a cent of its low into a print where the seasonal trough quarter rolls off; instead the only visible narrative in the wire is the post-SPAC de-rate and the Nasdaq bid-price notice. Turnover of ~$10k/day means nothing here is arbitraged, which is why a mechanically derivable upstream read survives to the print.
findings.independence: MoneyHero's own Q1 2026 release gives the vertical/geographic mix this leans on (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/24/3316651/0/en/moneyhero-group-reports-unaudited-first-quarter-2026-results.html, 2026-06-24) and the Q4/FY2025 release gives the $20.0m/+$0.7m EBITDA proof point and the $73.4m FY revenue (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/04/30/3284754/0/en/moneyhero-group-reports-unaudited-fourth-quarter-and-audited-full-year-2025-results.html, 2026-04-30) - those two are one company-source cluster. Genuinely separate third-party corroboration: SGX securities turnover in June 2026 rose 72% YoY with SDAV at S$2.1bn, the highest cash SDAV in four years (https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/sgx-sees-record-commodities-highest-055536709.html); and Hong Kong long-term new office premiums rose 51.1% YoY in Q1 2026 per the Insurance Authority's provisional release (https://www.asiainsurancereview.com/News/View-NewsLetter-Article/id/96375/type/eDaily/Hong-Kong-insurance-premiums-surge-32-to-US-37-4bn-in-first-quarter-of-2026).
findings.shared_source_note: Sized as one finding, not three, because the revenue leg and the EBITDA-inflection leg rest on the same revenue assumption; splitting them would double-count one number.

findings.finding: The single largest and most volatile line in MoneyHero's income statement is 'foreign exchange differences', which no estimate can contain: it was -$2,404k in Q1 2026 (vs +$954k in Q1 2025), +$26k in Q4 2025, -$8,921k in Q4 2024, +$4,818k for FY2025 and -$4,783k for FY2024 - i.e. it swings by multiples of the company's entire operating result, and the historical sign maps to USD strength (USD/SGD monthly averages were 1.2799 in March 2026 rising to 1.2884 in June 2026, with 2026's USD high of 1.2979 printed on 24 June, six days before quarter end), pointing to another non-cash FX charge in the Q2 headline rather than a reversal.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the mechanism of the last print's -18.91%: Q1 2026 revenue was +15% YoY and Adjusted EBITDA improved 68%, yet the stock fell a fifth because the reported net loss widened to $6.7m, of which $2.4m was unrealized FX and $1.1m fair-value changes. The one published estimate of EPS -$0.02 implies roughly a $0.9m net loss on ~45m shares, which is arithmetically impossible to reconcile with a P&L line that has averaged around plus or minus $3m a quarter - so the estimate, and therefore any headline 'beat/miss' the wires print at 08:00 EDT, embeds zero FX. If the market had priced this it would not carry a point estimate that assumes the largest line item is zero.
findings.independence: The FX line values for Q4 2025, Q4 2024, FY2025 and FY2024 come from a different document - the FY2025 results release (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/04/30/3284754/0/en/moneyhero-group-reports-unaudited-fourth-quarter-and-audited-full-year-2025-results.html, 2026-04-30). The currency path is from an unrelated source: USD/SGD 2026 monthly averages, X-Rates (https://www.x-rates.com/average/?from=USD&to=SGD&amount=1&year=2026). Caveat recorded honestly: the implied notional needed to generate a $2.4m loss on a ~1% USD/SGD move exceeds MoneyHero's disclosed cash, so the exposure is not purely SGD spot and the sign inference is weaker than the volatility inference - hence the wide band spanning zero.

findings.finding: Three days before the print, MoneyHero's Philippines platform Moneymax announced a new acquisition partnership with East West Banking Corporation for personal loans (announced 2026-09-07, released 2026-09-08), which cuts against the Q1 narrative that management is deliberately shrinking the lower-margin Philippines business - Philippines revenue fell 12% YoY to $1.5m in Q1 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: The release landed on a name that trades roughly 11,400 shares a day and drew no visible price response (the stock is still within 1.2% of its 52-week low). A partner-signing three days before results is also a soft tell that management is not walking into the call defensively; if it had been read that way the stock would have moved off the low ahead of the print.
findings.independence: The Philippines revenue decline it cuts against is from MoneyHero's Q1 2026 release (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/24/3316651/0/en/moneyhero-group-reports-unaudited-first-quarter-2026-results.html, 2026-06-24) - that release is also used in finding 2, so treat the two as sharing one document.

searched_and_found_nothing: No reverse-share-split proposal, share-consolidation authority, EGM notice or Nasdaq Capital Market transfer application anywhere in the EDGAR filing stream (last 6-Ks are 2026-08-13 Nasdaq notice, 2026-08-28 results date); the deficiency notice itself is public since 2026-08-13 with a 2027-02-03 compliance deadline, so it is in the wire and there is no sign of a split landing with this print

No going-private proposal, 13D, tender offer or strategic-review filing; the only 2026 13G is TD Securities at ~6.8% held through $11.50 warrants, i.e. an economically worthless position, not a real stake

The nine Form 4s filed 2026-08-07 are all RSU grants at $0 to directors and officers (Wang 42,556; Chan 42,556; Syz 42,556; Teichman 42,556; Thong 10,110; interim CEO/CFO Leung 20,065; CCO Thakur 12,051) vesting 2026-08-17 - no open-market insider buying or selling in the run-in

No permanent CEO appointment: Danny Leung has been interim CEO since 2026-04-02 and was still styled interim on the 2026-08-07 Form 4, five months into the search; Rohith Murthy left the board 2026-05-26. Public since April, so priced, and no evidence a successor lands with the print
No layoff, office-closure, or market-exit reporting for Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan or the Philippines in local or trade press
No Q2 pre-announcement, no guidance range issued at any point (the company has given none for 2026), no analyst preview beyond the single EPS estimate

HKMA Q2 2026 credit card lending survey (receivables -2.1% QoQ to HK$154.6bn, charge-off 0.61% vs 0.56%) reads mildly negative for the card vertical, but the same series fell 3.8% in Q1 2026 while MoneyHero's Hong Kong revenue rose 33%, so receivables are not a usable read on new-card acquisition and I dropped it
Could not obtain app-store review volume/rating trends or third-party web-traffic series for moneyhero.com.hk, singsaver.com.sg, money101.com.tw or moneymax.ph
No usable option chain exists, so there is no priced directional statement and no skew to test the findings against
baseline_tension: Nothing in the baseline pushes back: there is no option chain and therefore no skew, and the recorded 1.5% median reaction is a 6-K text-match artefact rather than an earnings base rate, so my net +2.0 is not contradicted by any priced expectation - it does, however, cut against the -10.2% 20-day run-up and the 62% de-rate, which is the only directional statement the tape makes and which the free control (-run_up_20d) would read as bullish too, so my positive tilt is partly redundant with that control.
capacity_note: Untradeable in practice: ~11,400 shares and under $10k of turnover a day. The magnitude above is not shrunk for that.
